items.title: Assam prohibits drone operations near Amur falcon roosting sites
points: A flock of Amur Falcon (Falco amurensis) flies over the Doyang in Wokha district of Nagaland, India, 10 November, 2018.
Every year over a million of Amur falcons come to Nagaland for roosting before they fly off to Somalia, Kenya and South Africa.
Apart from Nagaland a large number of Amur Falcons also roost in parts of Manipur, Meghalaya and Assam states.
These migratory birds have one of the longest migration routes of all birds, doing up to 22,000 km in a year.

The order banning such operations followed reports of content creators and visitors flying drones close to congregation and roosting sites of the migratory raptors, apparently to capture photographs and videos for social media.

It also directs the Divisional Forest Officers concerned to identify and demarcate sensitive roosting areas, ensure effective monitoring and protection, and coordinate with district administrations and police authorities for enforcement.
“Amur falcons are remarkable migratory birds, and their congregation sites in Assam are important stopover locations during their extraordinary annual journey.

items.title: BMW F 450 GS Sport Variant Launch Price Rs 5.90 Lakh
points: At the time of its launch in India, the BMW F 450 GS was offered in three variants – Base, Exclusive and GS Trophy.
BMW has now introduced a new Sport variant, positioned just below the top-spec GS Trophy variant.
Priced at Rs 5.90 lakh, the new F 450 GS Sport variant is Rs 35,000 costlier than the Exclusive variant and Rs 25,000 more affordable than the GS Trophy variant.
BMW is offering the F 450 GS Sport variant in an exclusive Racing Red colour option.
F 450 GS Sport is essentially the GS Trophy, without the Easy Ride Clutch (ERC), which is available exclusively with the GS Trophy variant.
Coming to equipment, the new Sport variant of BMW F 450 GS has sport suspension, Gear Shift Assistant Pro, offroad footrests, clear windshield and hand protection.
Powering the F 450 GS is a 420cc twin-cylinder engine that produces 48 hp and 43 Nm of torque, paired with a 6-speed transmission.

items.title: Deepavali 2026: All you need to know about Supreme Court-permitted time slots, green crackers and other directives
points: The unregulated use of firecrackers during Deepavali has historically led to a sharp rise in the Air Quality Index (AQI) and pollution levels, including the emission of particulate matter, the court observed.

“The right of an individual to engage in a particular practice, which may have a religious colour, is only a qualified one and cannot go beyond the Constitutional restrictions,” the Supreme Court held.
The state had “utterly failed” to comply with the Supreme Court’s orders issued since 2015 to impose restrictions on fireworks, the Bench said.

In October 2025, the apex court had permitted the sale and bursting of green firecrackers in Delhi-NCR during Deepavali, subject to conditions aimed at balancing tradition with environmental and health concerns.

The court permitted the bursting of certified green firecrackers between 6 a.m. and 7 a.m. and between 8 p.m. and 10 p.m. on November 7, 2026 and the day after in the Delhi National Capital Region (Delhi-NCR).

items.title: Darbhanga airport gets defence nod for pilot training institute, BJP MP hails move
points: The proposed establishment of a pilot training institute at Darbhanga airport for aspiring pilots to receive aviation training locally has moved a step closer to reality, with the Union defence ministry granting a no-objection certificate (NOC) for setting…

The Bihar government's civil aviation department, in a letter dated November 5 to Darbhanga MP Gopal Jee Thakur, confirmed that the defence ministry had granted the requisite NOC on September 1, following a request from the state government.
Following the directive, the civil aviation department had approached the Union defence ministry on May 14, seeking the necessary consent and NOC for the proposed facility.
The defence ministry subsequently issued its clearance through a communication dated September 1, the letter said.
Gopal Jee Thakur, who is also the chairman of the Darbhanga airport advisory committee and BJP's Lok Sabha whip, described the development as a significant milestone for Mithila and north Bihar.

For the diamond industry, this presents an opportunity, but sustaining demand requires more than product innovation.
Strengthening transparency and access to dependable information is therefore a shared industry responsibility.

Accreditations such as ISO/IEC 17025, which sets requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories, provide an additional framework for demonstrating technical capability within an accredited scope.
While grading assesses a diamond’s characteristics, traceability documents its journey through the supply chain.
This has particular relevance for India, a major centre for diamond processing.
McKinsey & Company has estimated that 90 per cent of natural diamonds are cut and polished in India.

items.title: ‘We are all proud of her’: Thiruvananthapuram kin cheer Indian-origin Nithya Raman's historic win as Los Angeles mayor
points: Nithya Raman, who left Thiruvananthapuram for the US at the age of six, is back in the spotlight in her hometown, with her family's pride soaring as she prepares to become the mayor of Los Angeles.

For her relatives in the Keralam capital, Raman's electoral triumph is an emotional moment, bringing back memories of her early childhood in the Fort area, close to the famed Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple.
Her paternal aunt, Vanaja Sankar, who lives in Kumarapuram, recalled the family's ties with the city and said she was happy about Raman's historic win.
In a post on X, Satheesan said the victory was historic, noting that she would become the 44th mayor of Los Angeles and the first South Asian American to hold the post.
Raman, 45, a member of the Los Angeles City Council representing District 4, defeated incumbent Karen Bass, 73, in the November 3 election.
New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who took office in January 2026, is a Democratic Socialist.

items.title: Blast in AC unit at Ghaziabad's Vasundhara police outpost, probe underway
points: A blast was reported in an air conditioning (AC) unit inside the Vasundhara police outpost in Ghaziabad on Saturday, with one person injured in the incident.
The police launched an investigation into the blast at the outpost, which comes under the Indirapuram Police Station.

Indirapuram assistant commissioner of police (ACP) Suryabali Maurya said the “exact nature of the object” which had caused the explosion would be determined following a probe. #WATCH | Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh: An explosion was reported at the Vasundhara…

items.title: Mahindra To Launch 3 New Cars By June 2027 – Confirms CEO
points: During its Q2 FY27 results media briefing, Mahindra Automotive Sector CEO, Rajesh Jejurikar, announced three launches in the first half of 2027.
While names have not been revealed, these new launches could include the Vision S-based SUV (speculated to be Sub 4m Scorpio Sport), BE 07 and Scorpio Lifestyler pickup.
Mahindra will also introduce updates to an existing model and launch a new light commercial vehicle by June 2027.
Mahindra’s born-electric INGLO platform currently has three EVs – BE 6, XEV 9e and XEV 9S.
Mahindra BE 07 will take on rivals like Harrier EV, BYD Atto 3 and Vinfast VF7.
Another potential bestseller in the making, Mahindra Scorpio Lifestyler can give tough competition to rivals like Toyota Hilux and Isuzu D-Max V-Cross.
Scorpio Lifestyler will be competitively priced, with Mahindra already announcing that the pickup’s starting price will be below Rs 19.79 lakh (ex-sh).
Rajesh Jejurikar, Executive Director and CEO (Auto and Farm Sector) at Mahindra, said that the company is already operating above its full production capacity.

items.title: BJP opts for caution as Centre set to tweak UGC equity rules
points: As the Union government moves to revisit the University Grants Commission’s (UGC) 2026 equity regulations, the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) finds itself in a quandary.
The Scheduled Caste (SC), ST (Scheduled Tribe) and Other Backward Class (OBC) communities back the stringent safeguards against caste-based discrimination.
In a post on X, BJP’s Uttar Pradesh in-charge Vinod Tawde cited the Supreme Court hearing and the Centre’s plan to constitute a panel on the regulations.
Upper castes are estimated to be about 22% of the electorate in Uttar Pradesh and OBCs 43%.
The SCs account for 21%, and the STs 0.5%.
In Uttar Pradesh, where the BJP returned to power for a second time in 2022, covets the votes of OBCs, who were included in the protection under the 2026 UGC regulations.

A second BJP leader said the Opposition managed to create fear through their false narrative that the party wanted a brute majority to change the Constitution and do away with caste- based reservation during the 2024 national polls.

items.title: IIT to Rohini: 10 most polluted areas in Delhi amid ‘very poor’ AQI on Diwali eve
points: Delhi's overall air quality index (AQI) remained in the 'very poor' category on Saturday morning, with a reading of 365 a day before Diwali.

As many as 21 monitoring stations recorded 'severe' air quality, according to the 7am update on the HT Pollution Dashboard, which tracks the average readings from all monitoring stations reported by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
The CPCB calculates the hourly AQI at each monitoring station using a running average of readings recorded over the previous 24 hours.
An analysis by the HT Pollution Dashboard showed that 21 stations recorded 'severe' air quality, while 30 were in the 'very poor' category.

The 10 Delhi monitoring stations that recorded the highest AQI readings in the latest update were: Check the air at your nearest station, hour by hour, on the HT Pollution Dashboard at hindustantimes.com/breathe.

We have requested a review of certain villages including these areas based on the scientific assessment and applicable legal process so that eligible mineral resources can be considered for auctions while protecting ecologically sensitive locations,”…
Mining leases in areas provisionally identified as ecologically sensitive in the Western Ghats have been cancelled by the Supreme Court.
Goa is yet to auction leases in villages provisionally identified as Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive by the ministry of environment and forests, given the uncertainty surrounding their status.

items.title: BMW F 450 GS Sport Launched In India At Rs. 5.90 Lakh
points: GaadiWaadi - The new variant gets an exclusive Racing Red finish, sport suspension, Gear Shift Assistant Pro and Riding Modes Pro BMW Motorrad India has expanded the F 450 GS range with the launch of the new Sport variant, priced at Rs 5.90 lakh (ex-showroom).
The latest version gets a sportier visual treatment and a few additional hardware and technology upgrades over the standard motorcycle, completing the F 450 GS line-up in India.
The most obvious change is the exclusive Racing Red paint scheme.
The new colour highlights the familiar GS styling, while a clear Rallye windscreen and black hand protectors add to its purposeful appearance.
BMW has also equipped the Sport variant with off-road footrests and a plastic engine guard, giving it a more adventure-focused look.
There are some meaningful additions beyond the cosmetic changes, too.
The F 450 GS Sport gets Sport Suspension, which BMW says is aimed at improving performance and riding enjoyment.

items.title: Calcutta High Court restrains KMC polls until challenge on delimitation decided
points: The West Bengal government had passed a legislation in the State Assembly on August 12, redrawing the wards of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) and increasing the number of wards from 144 to 209.
Dipu Das, a former councillor of the city’s civic body had challenged the delimitation exercise before the Calcutta High Court.

The appeal by the petitioner challenged an October 29 order by Justice Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, who had refused to stay the State government’s delimitation notification proposing amendments to Schedule II of the KMC Act.
The development casts uncertainty over holding of the elections to KMC, something that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) government was keen on.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has on several occasions, expressed their preference to hold civic body elections in Kolkata and Howrah by the end of November or early December this year.

items.title: "7th Attempt On My Life": Abhishek Banerjee Alleges Attack On Kolkata Home
points: Trinamool MP Abhishek Banerjee has alleged an attack on his home in Kolkata following a clash between his party's workers and the BJP workers last night during his birthday celebration.
A shouting match ensued between the two parties' workers around 2 am in front of Banerjee's Kalighat residence after chants labelling someone a "thief".
The Diamond Harbour MP alleged that the "BJP goons" threw his supporters to the ground and beat them up with brickbats.
A video shared by Banerjee also showed some people tearing down banners and posters belonging to Banerjee.
"On June 19, following an incident in Sonarpur when I was returning from Delhi, an attempt was made on my life by individuals armed with guns.
Who has the time to kill Abhishek Banerjee?
Questioning the alleged involvement of the state police, he said, "Why is the State Police allegedly spying on and snooping around the office and residence of an elected Member of Parliament?

items.title: Late-night clashes outside Abhishek Banerjee's Kolkata residence as party workers celebrate his birthday
points: Eight people were allegedly injured in back-to-back clashes between two groups outside the residence of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (MAITC) national general secretary Abhishek Banerjee at Kalighat in south Kolkata between 2 am and 3:30 am on…

The clashes allegedly occurred between MAITC workers preparing for Abhishek Banerjee's 39th birthday (November 7) and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) supporters, although the police did not name any party.
A big police contingent has been posted outside Banerjee's home.
Several people have been detained," a police officer said around 7 am, requesting anonymity.
MAITC supporters alleged that BJP workers carried out an unprovoked attack while they were preparing to celebrate Banerjee's birthday.
If this is the state of the police in a BJP regime, then common citizens can easily understand how secure they are," Banerjee alleged before the media around 3 am.
He sat on a dharna outside his home till 6:30 am, although the violence ended hours before that, police said.

items.title: American national found dead in Gachibowli hotel room
points: An American national, Mitchell Brian Lee, 41, was found dead in his hotel room at Marriott Executive Apartments in Gachibowli on Thursday (November 6, 2026) evening.
Lee, a resident of California, arrived in Hyderabad on November 2 along with his business partner, David Wu, for professional work.
The two were staying at the hotel located at SLN Terminus.
According to police, Lee had not responded to phone calls since the evening of November 4.
When there was no response, hotel staff opened the door to his room, number 1218 on the 12th floor, at around 6:30 p.m. on November 5 and found him lying unconscious on the bed.
The hotel staff alerted emergency services.
A 108 ambulance team arrived at the scene and confirmed that he had died.
Gachibowli police subsequently reached the hotel, inspected the room and initiated an investigation.

items.title: After IAS Divya Mittal, UP PCS Officer Anupama Saroj Singh Quits, Hints At Political Entry
points: Anupama Saroj Singh, a former Deputy Commissioner of GST in Uttar Pradesh, has announced her decision to leave the state administrative service and explore a new role in public life.
Her decision has sparked speculation about a possible entry into politics.
The daughter of former MP Sushila Saroj and wife of Samajwadi Party spokesperson Anurag Bhadauria, Anupama has also had a career in music and films.
In a social media post on November 4, she described her decision as the beginning of a new journey with a fresh commitment.
In a video message, Anupama said the decision had not been easy.
Music has played an important role in shaping her outlook, Anupama said.
Speaking to NDTV, Anupama Saroj said she had been considering leaving her government job for nearly a decade before finally taking the decision.
Although Anupama has indicated that she wants to enter public life, she has not revealed when she plans to formally join politics or which political party she may choose.

items.title: Wall Street rebounds as chip stocks rally after heavy AI-related selloff
points: The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq finished ​higher, with technology, communication services and industrials stocks driving gains.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.46 per cent, the S&P 500 rose 0.31 per cent, and the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.1 per cent.
The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up 4.2 per cent after slumping in its biggest one-day drop since April 2025.
Nvidia rose nearly 3 per cent, after its worst day since January 2025, when the emergence of low-cost Chinese AI model DeepSeek hammered markets.

Other heavyweight chipmakers, including AMD, Intel, and Micron Technology, closed up between 5 per cent and 11 per cent, while Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX were also up 4 per cent and nearly 9 per cent respectively after losses earlier this week.
For the Nikkei - just like Wall Street the previous ‌day - it was the biggest one-day drop since US President Donald Trump's "Liberation Day" trade tariff panic of April 2025.

items.title: US National Found Dead In Hyderabad Hotel Room, Police Launch Probe
points: A 41-year-old US national was found dead under suspicious circumstances in his hotel room at Marriott Executive Apartments in SLN Terminus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad.
Gachibowli police of the Cyberabad Commissionerate have registered a suspicious death case and launched an investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding his death.
The US national was identified as Mitchell Brian Lee, a resident of California.
He had arrived in the city on November 2 along with his business partner, David, on a business trip.
According to preliminary information, Lee was staying in Room No. 1218 on the 12th floor.
He stopped responding to phone calls from the evening of November 4.
On November 5, at around 6.30 pm, hotel employees opened the room using a master key and found Lee lying unconscious on the bed.
They immediately alerted the 108 emergency ambulance service.

items.title: Officials assaulted in Rajasthan after cheetah attacks cattle
points: A forest team from Madhya Pradesh’s Kuno National Park, deployed to track a cheetah that had strayed into Karauli district in Rajasthan, was allegedly assaulted by villagers after the animal killed a buffalo calf in the area, police said on Friday.

He added, “An investigation is underway to identify the accused.” The incident took place in the Mandrayal area, where a cheetah identified as KGP-3, which had strayed from Kuno National Park, had been moving through the forests, officials said.
Alok Prajapati, 34, a forester with Kuno National Park, lodged a police complaint on Tuesday, alleging that five to six unidentified villagers assaulted and threatened members of the forest team.
According to the complaint, the cheetah’s movement was traced to an area under Chandelipura gram panchayat, within Mandrayal police station limits, where it had killed a buffalo calf.
A Kuno forest team was deployed to track the animal when villagers allegedly approached them, abused its members and attacked the team.

items.title: Hero Xtreme 125R Stealth Edition Launched At Rs. 1.16 Lakh With TFT & TPMS
points: GaadiWaadi - Hero Xtreme 125R Stealth Edition receives a 4.2-inch colour TFT, tyre pressure monitoring and unique Midnight Black paintwork Hero MotoCorp previously upgraded the Xtreme 125R to dual-channel ABS, selectable riding modes and cruise control.
The manufacturer has now introduced the Stealth Edition at Rs 1.16 lakh (ex-showroom) – Rs 6,700 above the existing dual-channel ABS variant.
The Stealth Edition comes in Midnight Black shade which is complemented by Pearl Red detailing on the fuel tank extensions, pillion grab rails and Xtreme graphics.
The motorcycle uses a 124.7 cc air-cooled, single-cylinder engine that makes 11.4 hp at 8,250 rpm and 10.5 Nm of torque at 6,500 rpm.

It is the first motorcycle in the sporty 125 cc segment to receive this technology and the system helps riders identify tyre pressure irregularities from the instrument console by reducing the need for frequent manual checks.
The existing dual-channel ABS version costs Rs 1.09 lakh (ex-showroom) and the Stealth Edition commands a Rs 6,700 premium.

items.title: Politician Buys 4 Brand New Toyota Fortuner Legenders: Gets Them Blessed By Religious Leaders [Video]
points: We have now come across one such video where a politician from Uttar Pradesh took delivery of not one but two new Toyota Legender SUVs and got them blessed in typical Indian fashion.
What is surprising in this case is the fact that a politician like Dr. Dhirendra Pratap Singh bought four Toyota Legender SUVs.

Compared to the Fortuner, the Legender comes with a sharper, sportier dual-tone exterior, a split-grille design, aggressive lower bumpers, split quad-LED headlamps with sequential turn indicators, and an exclusive dual-tone colour option.
The Legender uses the same 2.8-litre turbo-diesel engine that generates 205 PS and 500 Nm of peak torque.
It is available only with an automatic transmission, and Toyota offers the Legender in both 2WD and 4WD variants.
The price of the regular Fortuner starts at Rs 35.11 lakh, ex-showroom, but the Legender starts at Rs 43.35 lakh, ex-showroom, and goes all the way up to Rs 48.77 lakh, ex-showroom.

items.title: Enforcement Directorate challenges closure of money laundering case against NewsClick
points: The Supreme Court on Friday issued notice on Enforcement Directorate’s (ED) appeal, challenging the closure of money laundering case against news portal NewsClick and its editor-in-chief Prabir Purkayastha after the Delhi high court quashed the case on May 29.
A bench headed by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant along with justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana passed the order while posting the matter for hearing on December 14.
The portal was probed by the Economic Offences Wing (EOW) of the Delhi police on allegations of receiving foreign funding.

The police claimed that the portal’s holding company PPK Newsclick Studio Private Limited received large sums of foreign funds from entities in the US to ensure the country’s stability and integrity was compromised.
The police lodged a case under the stringent UAPA.
Based on this FIR, the ED launched a probe under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act in 2020.
The HC order of May 29 quashed both the cases filed by Delhi police and ED.

items.title: Jio vs Airtel vs Vi: Voice-Only Prepaid Plans Compared
points: Need a second SIM just for placing calls?
These plans forced operators to detach their voice+SMS plans from their respective data bundles.

Since the emergence of data plans in the country (3G onwards) all three operators did not offer standalone voice and SMS packs until the mandate was imposed, forcing users to sign up for data bundles even if they had no requirement for the same.
With the mandate now imposed, Airtel, Jio and Vi have started offering voice-only plans for their respective customers.
And there are also users who wish to connect their bank accounts to separate phone numbers (for calls and OTPs) that remain disconnected from the internet.

items.title: Haryana Police Step Up Security Ahead Of Diwali To Curb Theft, Snatching Cases
points: Ahead of Diwali festival, Haryana's Bhiwani Police came up with a special security plan to ensure that pickpockets, chain snatchers and thieves do not spoil the festive mood.
Keeping a close watch on the heavy rush, police personnel were deployed across major markets, with some even stationed on elevated watchtowers carrying binoculars to monitor suspicious movements.

The special security drive was aimed at preventing thefts and snatching incidents as people stepped out in large numbers to purchase jewellery, utensils and other items on the auspicious occasion of Dhanteras.
In an unusual surveillance arrangement, police personnel were positioned on specially erected elevated platforms, locally known as machans.
Armed with binoculars, they kept a close eye on crowded market lanes and monitored the movements of suspicious individuals.
At the same time, police teams conducted foot patrols to ensure a visible security presence and respond quickly to any suspicious activity.
Four major market locations — Dadri Gate, Jain Chowk, Clock Tower and Bichla Bazaar — were identified as key security points.

items.title: BJP plans special event on Advani’s 99th birthday
points: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has planned a special celebration for party patriarch Lal Krishna Advani’s 99th birthday on Sunday, people aware of the details said.

Party president Nitin Nabin will preside over the function and senior leaders who have had a long association with the BJP stalwart will be present on the occasion, the person cited above said.
Born in undivided India in Karachi, Advani is a recipient of the country’s highest civilian award, the Bharat Ratna.
He was a member of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh, the ideological parent of the BJP.
A former deputy PM, Advani began his political journey in 1951 by joining the Bharatiya Jana Sangh, which was the precursor to the BJP.
He was elected to the Lok Sabha seven times and was also a four-time member of the Upper House.

items.title: Married UP Man Sets Self On Fire In Delhi After Friend's Daughter Refuses To Marry Him
points: The victim, Sandeep, was a resident of Sant Kabir Nagar in Uttar Pradesh, where he lived with his wife and two children.
He frequently visited a friend's house, during which he developed feelings for his 20-year-old daughter, who works at a utensil factory in Wazirpur and lives alone in Delhi.
According to police, Sandeep would often call the woman, and she had stopped speaking to him for some time.
On Friday, he reached the factory carrying two bottles of petrol and insisted the woman marry him.
When she refused, he poured petrol on himself and set himself on fire, police said.
Factory workers rushed to his rescue, doused the flames and took him to Deep Chand Bandhu Hospital, where doctors declared him dead.
In the suicide note, Sandeep claimed that the woman broke off their friendship and blamed it for his self-immolation.

items.title: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph passes away
points: He joined the India Meteorological department (IMD) in 1957 and went on to serve as the director of the IMD Meteorological Training School from 1979 to 1989.
He later served as an Emeritus Professor at Cochin University of Science and Technology.
He discovered the low-level monsoon jetstream and conducted extensive research on monsoon onset, Rossby waves, and ocean-atmosphere instability.
After taking voluntary retirement from the IMD in 1989, Joseph took up various assignments in India and the United States.
He was honoured with the Hari Om Ashram Prerit Dr. Vikram Sarabhai Research Award (1978), National Award in Atmospheric Science & Technology (2016), and the Sir Gilbert Walker Gold Medal (2021).
Having obtained a PhD from the University of Pune in 1983, he had published around 70 research articles.

items.title: Genuineness of Thachankary’s hospitalisation needs to be examined thorougly: Kerala High Court
points: The genuineness of former Director General of Police (DGP) Tomin Thachankary’s hospitalisation during his incarceration in the disproportionate assets case needs to be examined thoroughly, the Kerala High Court has observed.

Badharudeen had sought Thachankary’s medical records from the Poojappura Central Jail Superintendent while considering his plea for modification of his bail condition restricting international travel.
Thachankary had informed the court that he was employed in the United Arab Emirates and would lose his livelihood if he did not resume work soon.
The court orally remarked that Thachankary had “10,000 ailments while in jail but was fit for a job outside the country as soon as he was released,” and that there was a “severe contradiction”.
The court said it would not hesitate to cancel Thachankary’s bail if it was found necessary.
The court was informed that Thachankary was sent to the Central prison on September 17 and had remained in the prison hospital block continuosly till his release on bail on October 15.

Dhanuraj, chairman of the Centre for Public Policy Research, said it was high time the government put in place seamless public infrastructure, including footpaths, and a well-networked, modern public transport system.
